senses.definition: To deliberately avoid something you could have chosen, usually on principle.
distractors: To make a bad situation worse than it already was.
To put right something that was wrong, such as an error or an imbalance.
To back a claim with evidence that someone else can check for themselves.
To turn a structure that only exists in memory into something you can store or send.
To replace a running part of a system without stopping the system around it.
